svg.text: Retrieve the top 5, an LLM says whether they are enough to answer.
e.g. SciFact claim 54: AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) activation increases inflammation-related fibrosis in the lungs.
gold document: Metformin reverses established lung fibrosis in a bleomycin model
lilac: input | yellow: needs OPENAI_API_KEY | green: plain code | blue: Qdrant or shared part | e.g.: output of a real run
